title: Ada and the Blue Hour
author: Coral Ashgrove
blurb: Edmund Pemberton, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return to the place where the story went wrong before the house sale closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
